title: Agent account record
description: One enrollment slot of an agent runtime and the account signed in to its home (proposals/0012-agent-accounts.md, ADR-0051): the account id is derived from the verified login principal by a keyed hash, never named by hand; the principal itself and every token stay inside the runtime (INV-8).

accountId.description: `<provider>:<h>`: `h` the first 16 hex characters of `identity.hmac`. Absent until a principal was read whole.

provider.description: The agent runtime kind that signs the account in and reads its identity: the identity namespace.

slot.description: The enrollment slot: a home and nothing more. Its number never names, orders, or identifies an account.

home.description: The slot's owner-only home directory, an absolute path under the DSH home.

status.description: `enrolled`: a slot is taken, its sign-in not yet verified; `ready`: signed in as the pinned principal; `signed-out`: the runtime's own sign-in check fails; `quarantined`: see `quarantine`. Only `ready` admits a Worker.

reason.description: `changed`: the home signs in as another principal; `ambiguous`: the principal cannot be read whole, or its short id collides with another; `duplicate`: two slots resolve to one principal; `unverified`: the runtime or its version has no verified reader.

hmac.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the provider and the canonical principal parts, keyed by a per-install key kept in the credential vault; compared in full.

reader.description: The runtime's identity reader that read it, pinned to the CLI versions a supervised check verified.

hint.description: A masked hint for the operator (the first letter and the domain of an email), when the runtime shows one; local only, never sent to a Worker.

allOf.description: A ready account has its id and its verified identity, and no quarantine.
A quarantined account says why; no other status carries a quarantine.
A changed or duplicate principal was read whole, so the account it was is named.
